title: Reduction to a nontrivial language
statement: Let $L$ and $L'$ be languages of binary strings. Suppose $L$ contains at least one string and omits at least one string, and $L'$ belongs to $	extsf{NL}$. Then $L'$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $L$.
